titolo: Prepare Market Data for Forecasting with NVIDIA Megatron Core
descr: NVIDIA releases an open‑source preprocessing and training workflow for transformer models that forecast returns and volume from intraday market‑bar data.
paragrafi: NVIDIA announced that its Megatron Core library now includes GPU‑optimized components for training transformer models on large financial time‑series datasets.

The accompanying Megatron‑LM repository provides pre‑configured scripts that convert intraday market‑bar Parquet files into tensors, grouping bars into patches and sliding fixed‑length context windows.
Temporal safeguards split data by date with embargo periods to prevent leakage and compute target statistics only from the training split, avoiding forward‑looking bias.
perche: The workflow lets quantitative analysts build and train large transformer models without writing custom data pipelines, accelerating research on market prediction.
